note: Entry 0 of the 36-entry table is a dummy (SPEC-02 section 3.3); skills use ids 1 to 35.

skills.name: Bludgeon
skills.effect: To-hit level for items whose skill byte is 1 (clubs, bars).

skills.name: Edged arms
skills.effect: To-hit level for items whose skill byte is 2 (knives, hatchets).

skills.name: Grappling
skills.effect: To-hit level when no weapon is equipped; unarmed attacks per action = 1 + floor(level / 2).

skills.name: Handgun
skills.effect: To-hit level for items whose skill byte is 4 (pistols).

skills.name: Longarm
skills.effect: To-hit level for items whose skill byte is 5 (rifles).

skills.name: Spreadgun
skills.effect: To-hit level for items whose skill byte is 6 (shotguns). No such item in Dry Fork.

skills.name: Autofire
skills.effect: To-hit level for items whose skill byte is 7 (burst weapons). No such item in Dry Fork.

skills.name: Hurling
skills.effect: To-hit level for items whose skill byte is 8 (thrown). No such item in Dry Fork.

skills.name: Tube launcher
skills.effect: To-hit level for items whose skill byte is 9. No such item in Dry Fork.

skills.name: Archery
skills.effect: To-hit level for items whose skill byte is 10. No such item in Dry Fork.

skills.name: Evasion
skills.effect: Adds its level to the member's AC.

skills.name: First aid
skills.effect: When the member uses a medical item, the heal adds 2 x level.

skills.name: Bonesetting
skills.effect: Use on an unconscious member: skill check, difficulty 20; success sets the target to 1 HP and conscious.

skills.name: Tumblers
skills.effect: Named by barrier checks (locks).

skills.name: Strongbox
skills.effect: Named by barrier checks (safes).

skills.name: Scaling
skills.effect: Named by barrier checks (cliffs, walls).

skills.name: Fording
skills.effect: Named by barrier checks (water).

skills.name: Lookout
skills.effect: Surprise check at encounter start uses the best Lookout in the party.

skills.name: Trailcraft
skills.effect: Random encounter chance on map 0 falls by 5 per level of the best member.

skills.name: Haggling
skills.effect: Buy and sell prices use the best Haggling in the party.

skills.name: Smooth talk
skills.effect: Lowers an NPC's leader-CHA requirement by 2 per level of the slot-1 member.

skills.name: Gunsmithing
skills.effect: Unjam check uses it; each level lowers the member's jam chance by 1 point (minimum 1).

skills.name: Circuitry
skills.effect: Named by barrier checks (wired locks).

skills.name: Blasting
skills.effect: Named by barrier checks (charges).

skills.name: Engines
skills.effect: Named by barrier checks (machinery).

skills.name: Salvage
skills.effect: Victory money adds 5 x best level per monster killed.

skills.name: Quiet foot
skills.effect: Random encounter chance on maps 1 to 3 falls by 5 per level of the best member.

skills.name: Foraging
skills.effect: Rest heals each conscious member an extra HP equal to the best level.

skills.name: Terminals
skills.effect: Named by barrier checks (consoles).

skills.name: Signals
skills.effect: Named by barrier checks (radios).

skills.name: Mapcraft
skills.effect: Named by barrier checks (route finding).

skills.name: Beast lore
skills.effect: Named by barrier checks (animals).

skills.name: Dice and cards
skills.effect: Named by barrier checks (games of chance).

skills.name: Old script
skills.effect: Named by barrier checks (inscriptions).

skills.name: Command
skills.effect: Flee chance adds 5 x level of the slot-1 member.
